case_name: Manjit Singh And Others vs The State Of Punjab
facts_of_case: Murder Reference No.3 of 2008; Manjit Singh, Satwant Singh, Harwinder Singh, and Harjinder Singh were convicted for the culpable homicide amounting to murder of Baghel Singh; order of sentence was death, subject to confirmation of this Court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the evidence against him is unreliable.
legal_principles.held: All the injuries were found to be ante-mortem in nature and were sufficient to cause death in the ordinary course. The probable time between injuries and death was found to be immediate and between death and post mortem about 3 to 5 days.

legal_principles.principle: The court can rely on expert opinions and scientific reports to determine the cause of death.
legal_principles.held: PW11-Dr. A.S. Thind, Additional Professor, Department of Forensic Medicine, GGS, Medical College & Hospital, Faridkot, has conducted the post mortem examination on the dead body of an unknown male on 28.1.2003.

outcome.final_order: Sentence modified from death to (not specified); appeal allowed
